steps.title: Hex Machine
steps.content:
Hex Machine

Connect machines, convert their hexadecimal values into binary, add the binary values together, then compress the result back into hexadecimal to build stronger machines. The game saves locally as you play, and you can use the Save and Load buttons to store your progress in Google Drive.

Move
Drag machines
Merge
Drag amber socket to another machine
Convert
Hex to binary, then binary to hex
Goal
Build the strongest machine
